outcome: Know which room a device is near.

views.title: Presence rooms card
views.condition: Add the supplied Lovelace cards to your dashboard.
views.layout: Native Home Assistant cards; no dedicated tablet layout declared.

setup: Position a USB-powered BLE proxy in each area you want to observe.
Configure ESPHome and Bermuda, then map people and area names in your home inputs.
Optionally wire the radar using its guide; verify radar presence separately from BLE room estimates.

states.label: Living room
states.headline: Alex is near the living-room proxy
states.detail: Bluetooth signal estimates a device’s room. It does not prove a person is there.

states.label: Office
states.headline: The estimate follows the device
states.detail: A different nearby proxy changes the sample room estimate.

states.label: Add radar
states.headline: A second, separate signal
states.detail: The optional radar measures presence and distance, not a person’s identity.
